column7:
Surrender of ` 650.00
lakh was attributed to
anticipated saving in
this unit for demand of
arrear amount of earlier
bill by BSNL and
appointment, posting
and training of 44 new
Sub-Election Officers
under Election
department. Reasons
for final saving have
not been intimated
(August 2023).
